evidence: Landed under 'UTXO Db and Indexes', modifying chainstate database compaction checks across src/dbwrapper and src/txdb.
rationale: Prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting available disk space. As reported in #36585 on v32.0rc3, LevelDB compaction can double disk usage and fill disks on tight margins; checking free space before compacting directly addresses this reliability regression.
